narrative.intro: Battelle Energy Alliance received $90.5M in federal contract obligations in FY27 to date. The vendor recorded 1 award so far, with an average award size of $90.5M. Obligations are down 96.2% year over year compared with prior fiscal years. Historical obligations show larger annual totals: FY22 was $1.6B, FY23 was $2.2B, FY24 was $1.9B, FY25 was $1.9B, and FY26 was $2.4B. The FY27 to date total is a partial fiscal-year figure and reflects current-year obligations only. This profile shows that the current-year activity is a small fraction of recent full-year obligation levels. Use the FY22 through FY26 figures to gauge the vendor’s recent annual scale, and treat the FY27 number as incomplete for a full-year comparison.
